settings.quote: “Hello, my name is Ming, founder of EchoByJMG. EchoByJMG is born from JM Group Limited, a family-owned knitwear specialist since 1946. For over 80 years, we have produced knitwear for some of the world’s most respected luxury and high-street labels. We know our materials deeply: their quality, their character, and how much is left behind after every production run. EchoByJMG is our answer to that knowledge.”
settings.caption: Ming, founder of EchoByJMG
settings.small: Why Echo? Our yarns began as part of fashion production. Instead of being forgotten, they continue their story here. It is also an echo of heritage: generations of knitwear knowledge carried into something fresh.

settings.title: A fashion order ends
settings.text: Premium yarn is ordered for luxury and high-street production. Some is always left on the shelf, never worn, never used.

settings.title: The leftover is logged
settings.text: Fibre, colour, weight and batch. [How it is tracked today, to confirm with Ming.]

settings.title: We design around it
settings.text: We don’t order materials to match a design. We design around what we have rescued. The yarn comes first, the collection follows.

settings.title: A numbered edition
settings.text: When a rescued batch is gone, it is gone. No reorder, no restock, no repeat. Every piece gets its number and its Yarn Passport.

settings.heading: Knitted, not woven
settings.lead: A blanket with the structure of the best sweater you have ever owned: the softness, stretch and durability of fashion knitwear, at home.
settings.alt: Close-up of the Twister Rope cable knit

settings.heading: Colour, in a market of beige
settings.lead: Nordic does not have to mean pale. Our colours are whatever fashion left behind, which is why they are not on every other shelf.
